scope: Static UI/resource closure for VisionMaster Blob configuration surface; no product edits, no tool-plugins edits, no target execution
evidenceAuthority: Original installed artifact identity and static source/resource paths are primary evidence. Existing reconstructed tools may be used as a visual/implementation comparator only, never as proof of Blob original behavior.

sourceCallPath.confirmed: Returns if a parameter window is already open; checks module XML files; searches loaded AppDomain for <ModuleTypeName>Control; otherwise probes <module dir>/<ModuleTypeName>Control.dll; if a TabWinBase type is found it instantiates it, otherwise falls back to ParamsTabControlBase. Then sets ROI part/edit state/Params, owner, shows modelessly, and tracks close.
sourceCallPath.unknown: Which branch ran for the target Blob window and whether an extension assembly was already loaded in that runtime.

sourceCallPath.confirmed: Binds TabControlFx.ItemsSource to TabsA and SelectedIndex two-way to TabIndex; selection change invokes ChangeSelectedSubParamCommand; each visible tab is filtered via IsVisible; default content template is listTab -> ParamListView, with Panal tabs using gridPanal -> ParamUserControl.
sourceCallPath.unknown: Runtime tab/data values after SDK/provider callbacks.

sourceCallPath.confirmed: Default ContentTemplate is bound to DisplayType through UserTempConverter. Converter returns a DataTemplate at the matching key, or Default if absent. When Content comes from an assembly other than Apps.XmlParser/WindowsBase, the control attempts to merge that assembly's DataTemplate/ParamUserControlDataTemplate.xaml once per assembly.
sourceCallPath.unknown: Exact runtime Content CLR types and selected DisplayType keys for each Blob field; no Blob-specific Control DLL exists in its module folder, but AppDomain-loaded extensions are not ruled out.

branchAssessment.staticControlFactoryBehavior: If no already-loaded <ModuleTypeName>Control assembly exists and no module-directory Control DLL is found, generic ParamsTabControlBase is selected.
branchAssessment.runtimeObservation: No VisionMaster/VisionEditor process or visible parameter window was available in the current session when checked; AppDomain contents could not be observed.
branchAssessment.result: The generic fallback is source-proven conditionally, not proven as the branch selected in the prior Blob screenshot/runtime.
